# Appearance editor

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Material Design 3, appearance, and layout · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

main.ts `TONE_ELEMENTS` (4 parts x 4 tones), theme seed, large text

## What is missing

"Edit appearance…" on every element via context menu and keyboard; anchored non-modal editor; typography and image-layer editing; density and font controls; undo/redo, presets, copy/paste style, import/export; Animation and Transition tab; capability matrix
